Tooth Extraction Service at Clearwater, FL

BOOK NOW

Tooth Extractions & Wisdom Teeth Removal

We at Clearwater Dentist, in Clearwater FL, understand that tooth removal can be a frightening prospect, particularly when you are dealing with damaged, infected or decayed teeth. We are committed to offering expert extraction services, which prioritize your safety, comfort and overall health. Our team uses advanced techniques and high quality materials to remove problematic teeth in a safe and painless manner. We can address any concerns you may have, whether it's severe decay, an infection or damage caused by factors such as alcohol consumption.


Your comfort is our main goal throughout the entire extraction process. We listen to you, answer your questions, and develop a treatment plan that is tailored to meet your needs. Our gentle approach, combined with the latest equipment, ensures you receive the best care and support. We know that dental problems can affect your everyday life. That's why we make sure the extraction process is as smooth as possible. Our team will work efficiently to minimize pain and downtime so that you can quickly get back to living your life.


Clearwater Dentist offers professional and compassionate tooth extraction services for those who suffer from bad breath, decayed or damaged teeth caused by alcohol. We are committed to providing the highest quality care for your oral health. Call us to set up a consultation today and start your journey towards a happier, healthier smile.

Wisdom Teeth Removal in Clearwater, FL

At Clearwater Dentist, our specialty lies in offering wisdom tooth removal services for any issues with third molars. As wisdom teeth emerge, they can cause decay, discomfort and damage to neighboring teeth - our experienced team's wisdom extraction services prove indispensable in order to prevent dry socket complications and ensure safe extraction procedures are completed without incident.

 

Our highly experienced team excels at quickly and safely extracting wisdom teeth with minimal disruption and discomfort to daily life. We use cutting-edge tools and methods for optimal safety throughout this procedure; during recovery time we suggest sticking to soft foods to aid recovery.

 

No matter the complexity or urgency, Clearwater Dentist provides expert tooth extraction or wisdom teeth extraction services tailored to the unique needs of their Clearwater, Florida patients. Trust us to deliver comprehensive yet compassionate dental treatment that restores oral health and well-being.

Don't Live With Painful Teeth

Whether it is due to severe tooth pain, blood clot issues, damaged or infected teeth or considering implant-supported dentures, extraction may be required for optimal oral health. At Clearwater Dentist we offer gentle tooth extraction services when necessary - while our team strives to preserve natural teeth when possible, when severe infections or damage occurs extraction may be required for optimal oral wellbeing. We always strive to maintain your natural teeth as much as possible. Our team of experienced professionals uses advanced technologies and techniques to treat various dental issues and find solutions to maintain your dental structure. In cases of severe infection, extensive damage or when preserving a tooth could compromise your oral health, extraction is the best option.


A severe toothache can indicate a serious problem that requires immediate attention. Ignoring this pain can lead further complications. Our team provides timely and efficient extraction services in order to relieve discomfort and prevent oral health risks. In situations where implant-supported prostheses are considered, it may also be necessary to remove teeth. By removing damaged or problematic teeth from the mouth, you can provide a better foundation for dental implants. This will ensure a long-lasting outcome for your dental restoration.


Clearwater Dentist's commitment is to put your oral health first. Our comprehensive dental care includes a holistic approach, which considers all factors that affect your dental health. We make informed recommendations for optimal oral hygiene. We are here to guide you and provide compassionate care if you have dental issues that require extractions or you want to explore options such as implant-supported dentures.


Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya specializes in both traditional and advanced wisdom teeth extraction techniques to ensure you achieve optimal oral health outcomes. Once wisdom teeth removal has taken place, we often recommend replacing it with a dental implant which closely resembles its aesthetic appearance and natural function, giving your smile back its vitality and restoring dental health.

 

Our team excels in precise implant placement and restoration, ensuring you achieve complete smile restoration and excellent dental health following tooth extraction. The tooth extraction process is straightforward: local anesthetic will be administered to numb the area; for those experiencing extreme anxiety, oral or nitrous oxide sedation may also be available for an easier experience. Once numbed, we gently extract your tooth with most patients reporting only mild pressure when extracting their tooth from its socket.

 

Dr. Pokrovskaya takes great care in extracting teeth in order to minimize damage to supporting or nearby jaw structures and the risk of dry socket. After extraction, bone grafting may be performed to fill in any empty sockets left after tooth extraction - helping heal faster while simultaneously preparing the jaw for dental implant placement during the healing process. Trust Clearwater Dentist for comprehensive and compassionate tooth extraction services tailored specifically for you!

Common Reasons For A Tooth Extraction

If you wear dentures now or anticipate needing them shortly, implant-supported dentures can provide numerous advantages. At Clearwater Dentist, our experienced team is committed to walking you through every step of our implant and full-arch solution process for an enjoyable experience.

 

Implant-supported dentures follow similar steps as individual dental implants: after extraction if necessary and bone grafting to restore jaw volume, our team expertly places implants that serve as anchors for the denture appliance.

 

Once the implants are in place, we adapt a denture appliance to support them - typically two to four implants will do just fine - which allows your denture to snap securely onto these anchor points for an anchor. Implant-supported dentures give you confidence when speaking and eating knowing that your denture will stay secure in its place.

 

Reach out to Clearwater Dentist now to see how implant-supported dentures could enhance your quality of life and restore both its functionality and aesthetics.

Steps of a Tooth Extraction Procedure at Clearwater Dentist

1. Consultation: Meet with Dr. Nadia for a thorough examination and discussion about your dental health. During this visit, we will take pictures and x-rays of your teeth to ensure a comprehensive look at your oral health. This helps us understand your concerns and determine the best approach for your tooth extraction.


2. Treatment Planning: Based on your consultation, Dr. Nadia will create a personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. This includes deciding whether a simple extraction or a surgical procedure is necessary.


3. Preparing for the Procedure: Our team will ensure you're comfortable on the day of your extraction. We'll provide instructions for pre-operative care to ensure the best results.


4. Anesthesia: Dr. Nadia will administer local anesthesia to numb the area and minimize discomfort during the extraction. Additional sedation options are available for patients with dental anxiety if needed that will have already been established before your visit.


5. Extraction: Once numb, Dr. Nadia carefully removes the tooth. For simple extractions, she gently loosens the tooth and removes it. Surgical extractions may require a small incision or bone removal for safe withdrawal.


6. Post-Extraction Care: After the procedure, we'll provide detailed instructions for post-operative care. This includes managing pain and swelling and caring for the extraction site. We'll schedule follow-up appointments to monitor your progress.


7. Follow-Up Appointments: Our team is dedicated to your recovery. Dr. Nadia will schedule follow-up appointments to ensure healing is progressing well. Any concerns or complications will be addressed promptly.


8. Maintaining Oral Health: Once healed, Dr. Nadia will discuss options for replacing the extracted tooth if necessary, such as dental implants or bridges. Our goal is to help you maintain a healthy smile for years.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is tooth extraction painful?

It all depends on the doctor performing the extraction. A skilled doctor will remove teeth without pain. Most general dentists are not trained in all the complexities of extracting teeth, but Dr. Nadia has specialized training that allows her to extract all kinds of teeth, including wisdom teeth. 

What should I expect before, during, and after a tooth extraction?

Expect to have x-rays taken to identify the exact position of the tooth that needs to be extracted (removed). Once the doctor understands the location and position of the tooth, she will provide numbing to the area where the tooth is, and only when you are very numb will she remove the tooth. This is normally a very quick and gentle process. 

How much does a tooth extraction cost?

Extraction cost can vary from a few hundred dollars to several hundred dollars, depending on which tooth, and how it is sitting in the bone. 

What happens if I don’t get my wisdom teeth extracted?

Wisdom teeth can be fine without having them removed. Generally it is hard to clean those teeth since they are in the very back, and it is hard to brush and floss there. There are many reasons why dentists may recommend to remove your wisdom teeth. They may be stuck inside the bone (impacted), they may be sitting sideways, or they may be causing discomfort against other teeth. Many times, wisdom teeth, also called third molars, have no room and start hurting. 

How do I know if I need to have an impacted tooth removed?

Consult a dentist and ask him to explain his opinion and show you the xrays or the scan. At Clearwater Dentist, Dr. Nadia will take a full 3D scan to show you exactly how your teeth are positioned, and what she prescribes to fix the situation.
